title: When the Asset Sings Revisited
author: Wendell Montrose
blurb: Wren Ravensworth, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
